visual_pacing_and_cut_rhythm.anticipation_phase: 0.0s - 4.5s: 1 single holding shot (Character eye close-up or iconic dialogue line with quiet audio/reverb)
visual_pacing_and_cut_rhythm.build_up_phase: 4.5s - 12.0s: Medium pace cuts (1.5s - 2.0s per shot), character walking or preparing jutsu
visual_pacing_and_cut_rhythm.bass_drop_climax: 12.0s - 40.0s+: Rapid kinetic cuts (0.4s - 0.8s per shot) synchronized to drum kicks
visual_pacing_and_cut_rhythm.impact_accent: White flash strobe (2-3 frames) + micro screen shake (12-16px offset) on bass transients
visual_pacing_and_cut_rhythm.motion_slow_down: Holding 2.0s slow-mo freeze on decisive knockout punch or ultimate jutsu

color_and_texture_standards.contrast: 1.20 - 1.25 (Deep crushed pitch blacks in hair, clothing folds, shadows)
color_and_texture_standards.saturation: 1.30 - 1.35 (Boosted red Sharingan, blue Rasengan, golden Super Saiyan auras)
color_and_texture_standards.vignette: PI/4.4 (Darkening corners to pull attention into center action)
